lib.online_disclosure: Online artwork is optional. When on, the app asks the public libretro thumbnail server (thumbnails.libretro.com, plain web requests, one every 2 seconds, in the background) for the box art, an in-game picture and the title picture of each game, using the game's name from the built-in list (matched by the file's CRC32) or the file name; the server sees those names and your address, nothing else; there is no account or key. The pictures are community-maintained; they are fetched on your request, kept on your SD card, and never bundled or redistributed by us. Without a network the app shows generated and first-frame covers.
